title: Automatic Labeling and Control of Audio Algorithms by Audio Recognition
assignee: iZotope Inc.; current Google record shows Native Instruments USA Inc.
independent_claim_summary: Window audio; create and reduce a feature vector; assign a sound-object label; output control events that configure an audio application.
concrete_embodiments: FFT and MFCC features; statistics and PCA; GMM, HMM, SVM, neural-network or rule classifiers; real-time tool, chain, preset, or console control.
evaluation_and_limits: No classification accuracy, calibration, rejection, or downstream-harm evidence. A source label can be wrong, mixed, or musically irrelevant.
key_prior_art: Audio-classification and algorithm-control disclosures cited in the patent.
status_caveat: Google legal status and assignee are assumptions; verify official registers. Technical prior-art analysis only, not a legal or FTO conclusion.
review_method: Native-text claims and specification plus rendered checks of architecture and claim pages.
design_differentiation: Treat labels as provenance-bearing evidence with confidence, alternatives, unknown state, role and context; never as authorization to process.
alternative_design: Calibrated abstaining classifier feeding ranked typed hypotheses.
engineering_consequence: Production-ready principle: propagate source uncertainty into every dependent hypothesis.
acceptance_test: Clean sources, bleed, layered stems and OOD material; measure calibration, rejection and downstream plan harm.
must_not_infer: A likely source class proves musical role or desired processing.
interpretation_confidence: High for claims and architecture; none for classifier performance.
specialist_legal_review: Review before materially similar recognition-to-control implementation.

concrete_embodiments: Condition/action rules; genre and voice metadata; stem effects; virtual-stage and listener coordinates; weighted delayed-stem matrix.
evaluation_and_limits: No artistic-parity study and only partial transfer to TrackSmith stereo production. Source and genre metadata can encode brittle assumptions.
key_prior_art: Automatic spatial-mixing and stem-metadata disclosures cited in the patent.
status_snapshot: Google showed an expired-fee-related US signal.
status_caveat: Maintenance-fee and family status require official-register verification. Technical prior-art analysis only, not a legal or FTO conclusion.
review_method: Native-text claims and specification plus rendered independent-claim check.
design_differentiation: TrackSmith treats source metadata as evidence in typed, provenance-bearing, reversible hypotheses, not as a final genre lookup table.
alternative_design: Condition rules on role, section, confidence and user intent; retain spatial and no-change alternatives.
engineering_consequence: Prototype-worthy: inspectable metadata-derived rule and spatial assumptions.
acceptance_test: Misclassification, unseen labels, conflicting metadata and no-change baselines.
must_not_infer: Genre or source metadata determines a correct mix matrix.
interpretation_confidence: High for claims; moderate for current status.
specialist_legal_review: Consider before materially similar metadata-to-matrix implementation.

tracksmith_overlap: Cross-adaptive EQ, target matching, source-dependent cleanup, panning, dynamics and semantic rules.

title: Content Aware Audio Ducking
inventors: David N. Chen; David E. Conry
independent_claim_summary: Establish a minimum loudness separation between two clips in a multimedia composite and reduce the first during playback to meet it.
concrete_embodiments: Master-slave relationships; worst-case window differential; program loudness bounds; multiple pairings; silence and recovery behavior.
evaluation_and_limits: Rooted in multimedia or voice ducking, not general artistic music evidence. Can pump, suppress intentional overlap or react badly to transients and silence.
key_prior_art: Ducking and content-aware mixing disclosures cited in the patent.
status_caveat: Google legal status and assignee are assumptions; verify official registers. Technical prior-art analysis only, not a legal or FTO conclusion.
tracksmith_overlap: Declarative source-interaction constraint with an exact gain envelope.
design_differentiation: Expose priority assumption, envelope and preservation cost as a reversible plan.
alternative_design: Offer static balance, sidechain compression, dynamic EQ, arrangement advice or no-change depending on intent.

acceptance_test: Master-slave, silence, transient, recovery, pumping, preference and bypass-null tests.
must_not_infer: Measured overlap establishes which source should be reduced.
interpretation_confidence: High for claims; limited for music-production transfer.
specialist_legal_review: Consider before materially similar claim-element implementation.

independent_claim_summary: Calculate minimum and maximum average amplitudes, average them for a threshold, and gate below-threshold values; other independent claims cover compressor-ratio and common-channel variants.
concrete_embodiments: RMS and whole-file analysis; faster-than-real-time operation; margins, ranges and frequency weighting; discard extrema; map threshold ranges to ratios.
evaluation_and_limits: No listening evidence. Issued claim 1 is narrower and more gate-like than the title; mean-level heuristics ignore role, transients, crest structure and sections.
key_prior_art: Dynamics-processing and automatic-level disclosures cited in the patent.
status_caveat: Google legal status and assignee are assumptions; verify official registers. Technical prior-art analysis only, not a legal or FTO conclusion.

acceptance_test: Crest, activity density, genre, transient preservation, loudness matching and no-change.

specialist_legal_review: Consider before materially similar claim-element implementation.
